functions.recoveredRole: Moves selected curve entries from the insertion list back to the filtered available-curve view.
functions.behavior: Copies each selected insertion-list entry and its attached curve object to the available list, deletes the selected insertion rows with shift-safe iteration, and rebuilds the available list with active filters. An empty selection only causes a refresh.
functions.evidence: The DFM binds RemoveBtn.OnClick and CurveToInsertLB.OnDblClick to address 013ca490. The source iterates the list at form offset 0x7e0, tests selection with FUN_0068bca0, reads each selected string and object, adds that pair to the list at offset 0x778, deletes selected rows from 0x7e0, and calls FUN_013cab80 with false. The mirrored Add handler, resource labels, and OK-handler consumer identify 0x7e0 as CurveToInsertLB and 0x778 as AvailableCurvesLB.

functions.recoveredRole: Returns whether a list-box item is selected and raises an indexed list error when the native query fails.
functions.behavior: Gets the list-box window handle, sends LB_GETSEL for the requested item index, returns true for a selected item, and raises a formatted exception when the result is LB_ERR.
functions.evidence: FUN_0068bca0 obtains the control handle, sends native message 0x187 (LB_GETSEL) with the item index, compares the result with -1 (LB_ERR), formats an exception with that index, and otherwise returns whether the result is nonzero. Both transfer handlers use this result as their per-row selection test.
